ACCEPT — PR #7784 (services seat review, session `session_01JVfWSQN9RDDGwdVSmMc29x`).

What shipped: the durable record is now written by the party that observes the timeout. `runWithPolicy` gained a per-attempt recorder (`onAttemptStart`/`onAttemptSettled` with `timedOut` at guard-fire time); `DbJobAdapter.wrap` runs the handler under the policy and records from those callbacks, with a per-run `settled` latch as a second lock. `withoutPolicy()` strips `retryPolicy`/`timeout` from the registration handed to timer adapters so the budget is applied exactly once. `sys_job_run.status` lands `timeout` (guard message in `error`), `failure_count` increments, `attempt` carries the real number, and `replay()`'s synthetic row now mirrors any terminal status.

Review notes:
- All 4 changed files inside the claimed surface; changeset present; no `content/docs/releases/` edits.
- Tests assert durable-record cells only, including the overwrite race head-on (guard fires → handler later resolves → row stays `timeout`). Reverse verification: 9/10 fail on reverted seams; the 10th is the additivity pin, correctly green both ways.
- #7446's degraded-outcome seam is built on, not clobbered — its suite stayed green; the replay-mapping widening is accepted as in-scope (same defect wearing a `replay` tag).
- The pre-existing `trigger:'schedule'` attribution on manual `trigger()` runs (noted in the report) is out of scope here; it matches what #7595 addressed for automation runs — left unfiled since it may be intended; flagging for the next reader.

PR-side gate jobs all green (ESLint / TypeScript Type Check / Test Core ×3). Marked ready and queued at ~15:1xZ. ⚠️ Landing note: main is currently red in the queue's full-suite build (#7793, unrelated to this diff) — if the queue kicks this PR with that signature, it will be re-queued once #7793's stopgap lands.
